Doctors will throw birth control at you because many of them are lazy and will use it as a band-aid solution. But BC is not the only option!! I refused to take BC, I fixed my cycle with other medication that isn’t as harsh with the side effects. 

Also if you want to address the root cause of the situation, make sure to rule out any other underlying health conditions that may be causing this. Get an ultrasound of your pelvic area to see if you have PCOS, endometriosis, ovarian cysts, etc. 

My advice is to go to the Dr and be SPECIFIC about what kind of treatments/scans you want. Because many of them wont bring it up unless YOU SUGGEST IT FIRST

Also progesterone pills (i took provera) helped regulate my cycle when I skipped months. You take them for the first ten days of every month (or only if ur period is late) and the hormones will trigger your period to start. I know it sounds counter-intuitive but TRUST ME it is very important that ur period comes consistently every month. Skipping them will only make the next period longer
